text_block_list.text:
When Gold Ship called me into the waiting room,
she was vibrating violently.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Just trembling with excitement.
It actually helps me perform better!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And that's how the neighbor ends up complaining.
So, yeah, I'm counting on you to apologize to them!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right!! In top form today too!!
Golshi, launching nowwwwww!!

Since Gold Ship dashed off,
I apologized to the neighbors in her stead.
At any rate, she seems to be in top form today.
